<div class="ei-intro-body">Elfster is a FREE gift exchange website to make gift-giving easier. Our Secret Santa Generator makes Christmas, holidays and other gift exchanges free, easy, and fun!</div>

<div class="ei-section__content">
<h2 class="ei-section-title">Secret Santa</h2>
<p>Elfster’s online Secret Santa allows you to draw names so quickly and easily. You can invite people in an instant using WhatsApp, Facebook Messenger, Text Messages on your mobile phone, Email, a Sign Up Link, and you can even choose right from your Gmail contacts.  If you have any questions, we have live chat support 7 days a week throughout the holiday season to make sure you can have a perfect gift exchange and spend more time with your friends and family.</p>
